name: application-urgency
purpose: Prioritize already-eligible opportunities by evidence-based closing risk and freshness without weakening location or fit gates.

urgencyBands.apply-now: explicit deadline <= 48h or canonical explicitly says closing soon
urgencyBands.soon: explicit deadline <= 10 days or fresh canonical listing <= 72h old
urgencyBands.normal: active listing without stronger urgency evidence

rules: Urgency may reorder only jobs that already passed hard location and qualification gates.
Urgency must never promote reject-distance, locationEligibility unknown, inactive, or hard-mismatch jobs.
Keep original publication/deadline values unchanged and attach evidence timestamp separately.
If deadline evidence expires or canonical becomes unavailable, fail closed to unknown; do not delete an existing LIVE record solely for a transient fetch failure.
Do not modify stable IDs, canonical dedupe keys, CRM fields, sourceTrust, verifiedAt, scoreConfidence, locationEligibility, or locationReason.
